mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and may compete for CYP450 enzymes; tretinoin increases skin photosensitivity and irritation risk while terbinafine can cause photosensitivity, and concurrent use may increase dermatologic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation, photosensitivity, and hepatic function; counsel patient on strict sun protection and consider staggered application schedules if both topical agents are necessary.
